project_scope.current_batch: Batch 1 - common roadsides, prairie, and disturbed-site composites
project_scope.note: This is the initial Asteraceae family file for the current desktop build. Add later genera by merging, not by replacing the family file from scratch.

family_diagnostics.inflorescence: A head (capitulum) made of many small florets packed onto one receptacle.
family_diagnostics.floret_types: Heads may contain ray florets, disc florets, or both.
family_diagnostics.involucre: One or more series of phyllaries subtend the head and are often critical for identification.
family_diagnostics.fruit: Cypsela, often with a pappus of scales, awns, or bristles.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: To learn Asteraceae well, do not stop at flower color. Look at phyllaries, receptacle/paleae, leaves, pappus, and overall architecture.
